title: Lab - Role-based access control
description: Grant exactly the permissions a developer needs.
scenario: Grant exactly the permissions a developer needs. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Inspect
tasks.instructions: What authorization modes does the API server use, and which Roles exist in default?
tasks.solution:
kubectl describe pod kube-apiserver-controlplane -n kube-system | grep authorization-mode
kubectl get roles

tasks.title: Task 2 - Can I
tasks.instructions: Can user dev-user list Pods in default?
tasks.solution: kubectl auth can-i list pods --as dev-user

tasks.title: Task 3 - Grant
tasks.instructions: Create Role developer (list, create, delete pods) and bind dev-user to it.
tasks.solution:
kubectl create role developer --verb=list,create,delete --resource=pods
kubectl create rolebinding dev-user-binding --role=developer --user=dev-user
tasks.verification: kubectl auth can-i create pods --as dev-user  # yes
